QuestInfo.name: The Guru
QuestInfo.0: You hear a voice calling you. Find the person calling you and start a conversation.
QuestInfo.1: You meet #p9310540# at the Yu Garden bridge. He claims to be a guru of fire and wind. He says he's been around since Zhu Yuanzhang founded the country with Yingtian as its capital. \r\nHe says you have the face of a hero, and that once you are ready to embrace your destiny, you should speak to him again.\r\n
